## Fixed

- **Leaving an app plays one animation.** The closing animation waited for Android to finish shrinking the app, then covered the screen and played again. It now runs together with the app shrinking, and is shorter to match.
- **Themed icons stay themed when the wallpaper changes.** A wallpaper changer (a new wallpaper on each lock) makes the launcher rebuild every icon, and they came back plain. Any icon handed back plain is now made again straight away.
- **The feed keeps answering.** The link to the Google app was marked as low priority, so Android froze the Google app in the background and the swipe did nothing until the Google app was force stopped. The link now keeps the Google app awake while the home screen is showing.
